events.summary: Public-facing web server received exploit requests against the login endpoint before external TLS traffic began.
WAF telemetry also showed generic scanner payloads blocked earlier in the same window.
The web server resolved cdn-auth-check.net shortly after the exploit attempts.
Seed JA4 alert matched a possible web-shell beacon over TLS.
The same web server reconnected to the same external infrastructure after the seed alert.
A web-shell file named shell.aspx appeared under /var/www/html/.cache after the exploit traffic.
PowerShell launcher executed under w3wp and reached the same temporary web cache path.
Credential-store access from the web worker account followed the PowerShell launcher.
SMB connection from web-app-01 to app-db-01 followed the web-shell and PowerShell activity.
app-db-01 contacted the original external infrastructure after the lateral movement signal.

known_events.summary: Public-facing web server received exploit requests against the login endpoint before external TLS traffic began.
WAF telemetry also showed generic scanner payloads blocked earlier in the same window.
The web server resolved cdn-auth-check.net shortly after the exploit attempts.
Seed JA4 alert matched a possible web-shell beacon over TLS.
The same web server reconnected to the same external infrastructure after the seed alert.
A web-shell file named shell.aspx appeared under /var/www/html/.cache after the exploit traffic.
PowerShell launcher executed under w3wp and reached the same temporary web cache path.
Credential-store access from the web worker account followed the PowerShell launcher.
SMB connection from web-app-01 to app-db-01 followed the web-shell and PowerShell activity.
app-db-01 contacted the original external infrastructure after the lateral movement signal.
The database server resolved the same rare C2 domain after the SMB connection from web-app-01.
Remote service creation from web-app-01 to app-db-01 appeared after app-db-01 contacted the beacon infrastructure.
web-app-03 also reached the same hosting IP through a scanner telemetry vendor domain.
A planned hotfix deployment started after the suspicious chain and may explain later service restarts.
Script block logging was disabled on web-app-01, limiting command detail behind the PowerShell launcher.

我们也注意到了事件中存在的一些背景或替代性解释。例如，在攻击活动发生的早期同一窗口，即 `2026-05-11 14:04:40 UTC`，`web-app-01` 也曾收到来自同一源 IP 的、已被 WAF 拦截的通用扫描流量。这提示攻击者的初始行为可能混杂了自动化的漏洞探测，虽然后续的成功利用和恶意行为具有排他性，但理解这一背景有助于避免将所有来自该 IP 的流量都武断地归为成功入侵的一部分。此外，`2026-05-11 14:27:00 UTC`，数据库服务器 `app-db-01` 在收到来自 `web-app-01` 的 SMB 连接后，解析了相同的罕见域名 `cdn-auth-check.net`。这个行为看似可疑，但目前的日志并不能完全排除其是由于 `web-app-01` 作为代理或跳板所触发的正常解析请求，在没有 `app-db-01` 自身产生主动外联的证据前，它应被看作一个复杂的背景事件，而非 `app-db-01` 直接受控的铁证。

部分候选影响范围由于缺乏验证而不能被并入已确认的结论。扩线候选资产 `web-app-03` 和候选指纹 `t13d1517h2_91adbe210bc1_7cae1281e991` 均处于“待确认”状态。它们与已确认失陷资产共享了某些关键属性，是强有力的扩线线索，但当前没有任何关于它们自身发生漏洞利用、恶意进程创建或数据外泄的观测支撑。同样，`web-app-01` 上 `2026-05-11 14:55:00 UTC` 发生的脚本日志被禁事件虽具防守规避嫌疑，但仍停留在“候选事件”状态。这些对象和事件构成了报告中最关键的边界，绝对不能将待确认状态模糊处理为已受影响。

综上所述，核心结论的把握度上限受到上述未闭合缺口与背景解释的双重制约。由于缺乏更大规模的显式扩线、候选事件的独立验证以及对潜在反证（如维护操作）的检查，我们目前无法得出“事件影响范围仅局限于 `web-app-01` 和 `app-db-01`”或“所有关联指标均已处置完毕”这类更强的、已闭合的结论。当前高把握度的“确认安全事件”判断，是基于已观测到的、从漏洞利用到 WebShell 执行的连贯恶意行为链的最准确表述。

综合所有已确认证据，本次调查的最终判断为确认安全事件。`web-app-01` 的失陷过程清晰，攻击链从 Web 漏洞利用、C2 信道建立、WebShell 落地到后续命令执行，证据连贯且部分得到 JA4 指纹的恶意家族匹配支持。此结论已达到当前证据所能支撑的最高交付标准，后续所有行动都将围绕此确认范围展开。立即处置方面，建议优先对已确认受影响的资产 `web-app-01` 和 `app-db-01` 执行隔离或实施增强型监控。同时，在边界防护和代理设备上，对已识别出的核心外部基础设施 `198.51.100.88` 和 `cdn-auth-check.net` 进行排查和封禁，以切断攻击者赖以通信的控制通道。

confirmed_events.summary: Public-facing web server received exploit requests against the login endpoint before external TLS traffic began.
WAF telemetry also showed generic scanner payloads blocked earlier in the same window.
The web server resolved cdn-auth-check.net shortly after the exploit attempts.
Seed JA4 alert matched a possible web-shell beacon over TLS.
The same web server reconnected to the same external infrastructure after the seed alert.
A web-shell file named shell.aspx appeared under /var/www/html/.cache after the exploit traffic.
PowerShell launcher executed under w3wp and reached the same temporary web cache path.
Credential-store access from the web worker account followed the PowerShell launcher.
SMB connection from web-app-01 to app-db-01 followed the web-shell and PowerShell activity.
The database server resolved the same rare C2 domain after the SMB connection from web-app-01.
app-db-01 contacted the original external infrastructure after the lateral movement signal.
Remote service creation from web-app-01 to app-db-01 appeared after app-db-01 contacted the beacon infrastructure.
web-app-03 also reached the same hosting IP through a scanner telemetry vendor domain.
A planned hotfix deployment started after the suspicious chain and may explain later service restarts.
